translation: The Apostle of Allah (peace be upon him) used to recite in every rak'ah of the first two rak'ahs of the noon prayer about thirty verses and in the last two about fifteen verses or half. In every rak'ah of the Asr prayer of the first two rak'ahs about fifteen verses and in the last two verses half.

The sun eclipsed during the time of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). He stood in great anxiety fearing that it might be the Doomsday, till he came to the mosque. He stood up to pray with prolonged qiyam, ruku', and prostration which I never saw him doing in prayer. Then he said: These are the signs which Allah sends, not on account of the death of anyone or life of anyone, but Allah sends them to frighten thereby His servants. So when you see any such thing, hasten to remember Him, supplicate Him, and beg pardon from Him.

arabic: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلَاةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْرًا
translation: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Do not tell a lie against me, for whoever tells a lie against me intentionally will surely enter the Hell-fire.
